name: DeepBench
description: A benchmark dataset for function-level deep learning code generation covering different phases of the DL pipeline, tasks, and input data types. It evaluates LLMs' ability to generate DL code, revealing challenges and performance variations across categories.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark in the code-generation community, mainly cited for evaluating deep learning code synthesis across pipeline stages rather than as a broad general-purpose standard.
notes: More complex than existing benchmarks like DS-1000; includes taxonomy of issues in LLM-generated DL code.
